title: Report: Pentagon Undercounted US Troop Deaths in Iran War by at Least Four
detail: The Washington Post reported that at least 22 US service members have died in the Middle East since the Iran war began Feb 28 — four more than the 18 fatalities listed in the Pentagon's public Defense Casualty Analysis System — citing five US officials familiar with internal accounting (a sixth put the figure at 23). Officials said not all of the additional deaths were combat-related but involved personnel deployed to the theater during the conflict. The report reopens a dispute over Pentagon casualty transparency first raised by The Intercept in April.

media.caption: Washington Post report on undisclosed US troop deaths in the Iran war

title: Trump Says US 'Hopefully Toward the End' of Iran War
detail: President Trump said the United States is 'hopefully toward the end' of its war with Iran and that he has spoken with Iranian officials 'directly,' while reiterating that the conflict will not fully wind down until after the November midterm elections. The remarks came as a fire-pause on strikes into Iranian territory reached its ninth consecutive day, Iran's flag carrier suspended flights to Turkey and Georgia, and the rial traded near a record low.
